description: Ministry of Education - Degree awarding Institute Order of the Esoft Metro Campus (Pvt.) Limited
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends the schedule to a previous order regarding degree programs. It establishes regulatory conditions for a private educational institution (Esoft Metro Campus) to offer a specific degree program. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
